current.text: He is the third-string center in Detroit and is on a two-way contract.
Paul Reed is the backup center behind Jalen Duren, which puts Onyenso behind both of them.
Jalen Duren has not played in preseason and may be eased in. Paul Reed is the one expected to get the extra center minutes early.
He is a name to watch, not a player to draft now.

durable.text: He blocks shots at a very high rate. He averaged 2 blocks a game in Summer League as a backup big.
His translated fantasy stats ranked among the top three in his draft class.
He began taking threes in his last season before the NBA.
He could build fantasy value from blocks, rebounds and FG%, like Walker Kessler. Josh says his fantasy potential is through the roof.
